mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 46 degrees under overcast skies at Verona City Hall. We are currently under a first quarter moon. The overnight low will drop to 37 degrees, with no rain in the forecast.

City residents are invited to sign up for the digital newsletter to stay informed on important news, projects, and programs. Additionally, the Public Works Department reminds everyone they are available to assist with street and utility maintenance during regular business hours.

There is plenty to do in Verona today with trivia nights at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's or try out a yoga class at Insight Wellness.

In our weekly look at police activity, on November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in an East Verona Avenue parking lot, which resulted in an arrest for O W I involving a driver with a minor in the vehicle.
Today's flavor of the day is Caramel Turtle. The store is currently open and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so there is still time to stop by for a scoop.
